notes.title: Screen Recorder update 22.4 is here!
notes.notes:
Here are the new features now available in Movavi Screen Recorder 22.4:


 Set the time limit before or during recording. 
Press the timer button, set the time, and select the action after the recording ends. Simple and convenient!
https://new-img.movavi.com/products/0013/41/4cb90fd428bb57185fa80b61dbb31b45f5e4ab28.png
 The size of your recordings is now smaller, and the quality is better.
 
 Plus some other minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Screen Recorder update 22.2 is here!
notes.notes:
Here are the new features now available in Movavi Screen Recorder 22.2:


 Noise reduction
No need to worry about loud neighbors or colleagues any longer! Our new noise reduction feature will help you get rid of extraneous sounds.

 Audio control during capture
Forgot to turn the system sound on or disable the mic? Set your sound up during capture using the familiar buttons on the control panel.

 Minor improvements and bug fixes
